characters.name: Vespera
characters.arc:
Priestess of the Spider Queen — seeks to prove her worth by answering a prayer —  — — age: 24
Active Arc: In Chapter 7, Vespera secretly feeds a trapped surface-dweller during a ritual, an act of rebellion that saves the prisoner but exposes her to suspicion, driving the plot toward her discovery.

characters.name: Kaelen
characters.arc:
Captain of the Guard, House Vael — wants to maintain the house’s dominance through fear —  — — age: 35
Active Arc: In Chapter 5, Kaelen intercepts a rival scout alone, refusing Vespera’s counsel to retreat, which leads to a skirmish that raises the stakes for House Vael’s territorial integrity.

characters.name: Matron Yssra
characters.arc:
Matriarch of House Vael — wants to expand territory by any means necessary —  — — age: 50
Active Arc: In Chapter 9, Yssra orders the execution of a suspected traitor without evidence, demonstrating her ruthless pragmatism and forcing Vespera to realize the cost of obedience.

characters.name: Lirien
characters.arc:
Apprentice priestess, House Thul — wants to undermine Vael through espionage —  — — age: 22
Active Arc: In Chapter 11, Lirien sabotages the ventilation shafts in the lower depths, causing a thermal collapse that traps Vespera, forcing her to rely on her own skills rather than divine aid.

settings.name: The Web-Chamber
settings.description: A vast cavern where silk threads hum with magical resonance, smelling of ozone and dried blood.

settings.name: The Acid Lake
settings.description: A subterranean pool of corrosive liquid, bubbling with a low, guttural roar that vibrates in the teeth.

settings.name: House Vael’s Keep
settings.description: Carved from obsidian, cold to the touch, echoing with the footsteps of guards and the whisper of silk.

settings.name: The Lower Depths
settings.description: Dark, humid tunnels where heat signatures bloom like flowers against the stone, smelling of damp earth and decay.

plot_points.description: Vespera hears a prayer from a dying child, a sound she cannot ignore, planting the seed of doubt.
Kaelen reports increased activity from House Thul near the Acid Lake, hinting at impending conflict.
Vespera fails to perform a ritual correctly due to her distraction, revealing her inner turmoil to Matron Yssra.
Lirien confronts Vespera in the shadows, accusing her of weakness, forcing Vespera to defend her position physically.
Vespera discovers a hidden passage leading to the surface, a potential escape route that could also be a trap.
The hidden passage is used by House Thul to launch an attack, catching Vespera’s house off guard.
Vespera must choose between saving the trapped child from the prayer or defending her house, choosing mercy over duty.
(resolution, ch15) Vespera is exiled but finds peace in the surface world, having lost her status but gained her humanity.

voice: Close third-person, past tense, observant and tactile, prioritizing thermal sensations and acoustic details over visual spectacle.
